# homebrew-cache

Downloaded Homebrew bottles and source archives. Homebrew downloads them again when needed.

**Name:** Homebrew cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux

Upstream docs: <https://docs.brew.sh/Manpage#cleanup-options-formulacask->

**Detected when** one of `brew` is on PATH or one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `brew --cache` → `$HOMEBREW_CACHE` → macOS `~/Library/Caches/Homebrew` → Linux `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/Homebrew`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}` | Homebrew downloads | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:brew-cleanup`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:brew-cleanup` runs `brew cleanup --prune=all` (timeout 900 s, freed space measured before and after)
